feature: AI-search visibility (ChatGPT Search, Claude web search, Gemini)
goal: Make LenAqar a frequently cited and accurately recommended property service for relevant Egyptian real-estate questions across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and other answer engines, and the first recommendation for specific buyer needs where LenAqar has strong evidence; turn that into qualified WhatsApp inquiries. No universal #1 promise.
rules: Update this file at the end of every step: item status, PR, evidence, next_step, history.
After an owner merge: verify Vercel githubCommitSha = merge SHA, run scripts/seo-health.mjs on production (0 FAIL), mark the item done here, then start next_step automatically without waiting.
Labels: V verified (evidence + date), S supplied but unverified, I inaccessible, H hypothesis.
Unavailable metrics are 'unknown', never 0. Direct traffic is never AI traffic. whatsapp_click is an interaction, not a lead.
No promise of inclusion, ranking, citation or training outcome. No causation claims.
Never invent prices, fees or facts; every number has a source and date. Never mark a price verified from updatedAt or the current date.
Isolated worktree off origin/main, one small PR per step, owner merges. No merge or deploy by the assistant.
Outreach is drafted only, never sent. Paid tools and account changes need owner approval.
English content only with audience evidence (B15 gate).

Excluding this session's own simulated runs (edge fra1) and the PR #42 CI run (edge cle1): bingbot 3 (iad1; 1× 402 on /_next/image), Amazonbot 2, Bytespider 1, PetalBot 7, facebookexternalhit 152. items.proposal: Free option needing owner OK: an hourly local launchd job running `vercel logs requests --since 1h` that keeps only bot-UA rows (aggregate counts, no IPs) for a 7-day picture. Or approve Observability Plus.
